skills.name: dif-design
skills.purpose: Propose, compare, review and improve UX/UI designs with traceable evidence. Use for end-to-end design proposals; initial scope is registration and login across web and mobile.
inputs: User design request and supplied evidence
validation_rules: Run tools/check-skills.mjs; host behavior requires separate trials

skills.name: dif-evaluate
skills.purpose: Review design alternatives or existing UX/UI using separate rule, expert and empirical evidence, with findings and uncertainty.
inputs: User design request and supplied evidence
validation_rules: Run tools/check-skills.mjs; host behavior requires separate trials

skills.name: dif-explore
skills.purpose: Generate meaningfully different design alternatives and compare their assumptions, constraints and tradeoffs before visual detailing.
inputs: User design request and supplied evidence
validation_rules: Run tools/check-skills.mjs; host behavior requires separate trials

skills.name: dif-improve
skills.purpose: Generate conservative and radical improvements from a design review, retain provenance and compare quality before and after.
inputs: User design request and supplied evidence
validation_rules: Run tools/check-skills.mjs; host behavior requires separate trials

skills.name: dif-intake
skills.purpose: Extract design goals, audiences, constraints and assumption branches from requirements or existing UI material, especially registration/login requests.
inputs: User design request and supplied evidence
validation_rules: Run tools/check-skills.mjs; host behavior requires separate trials

skills.name: dif-ux-ui
skills.purpose: Detail registration/login flows, responsive screens, component states and mockup specifications for selected design candidates.
inputs: User design request and supplied evidence
validation_rules: Run tools/check-skills.mjs; host behavior requires separate trials

skills.name: dif-art-direct
skills.purpose: Translate brand meaning into concrete visual directions, compare screens and refine actual artifacts.
inputs: User design request and supplied evidence
expected_outputs: Comparable visual proposals, reference provenance and explicit uncertainty
validation_rules: Run tools/check-skills.mjs; host behavior requires separate trials
